PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?department ?departmentLabel (COUNT(?student) AS ?studentCount)
WHERE {
  ?department a eduo:Division .
  ?department eduo:label ?departmentLabel .
  
  # Count students associated with this department
  # Assuming students are linked to departments via some property
  # Since schema doesn't specify, we'll look for any relationship
  OPTIONAL {
    ?student a ?studentType .
    FILTER(?studentType IN (eduo:DoctoralCandidate, eduo:BachelorCandidate, eduo:Student))

  }
}
GROUP BY ?department ?departmentLabel
HAVING (COUNT(?student) > 100)
ORDER BY DESC(?studentCount)
